title: feat(plugin-workflow): FlowDesigner — spec v3.0.9 canvas-based flow editor
body:
Implements the Flow Designer roadmap item: a production canvas-based flow editor in `@object-ui/plugin-workflow` with full spec v3.0.9 type coverage, sitting between the approval-focused `WorkflowDesigner` and the BPMN-heavy `ProcessDesigner`.

## New types (`@object-ui/types`)

Added to `workflow.ts` and re-exported from the package index:

- **`FlowNodeType`** — 14 node types including v3.0.9 additions: `parallel_gateway`, `join_gateway`, `boundary_event`
- **`FlowEdge`** — `type: 'conditional' | 'timeout' | 'default'` + `isDefault` flag (spec v3.0.9 default edge marking)
- **`FlowNodeExecutorDescriptor`** — `inputSchema`, `outputSchema`, `waitEventConfig` (`FlowWaitEventType`: condition/manual/webhook/timer/signal), enhanced retry (`backoffMultiplier`, `maxRetryDelayMs`, `jitter`)
- **`FlowBoundaryConfig`** — `attachedToNodeId`, `eventType`, `cancelActivity`, `timer`, `errorCode`
- **`FlowVersionEntry`** / **`FlowConcurrencyPolicy`** — version history + allow/forbid/replace/queue policy
- **`FlowBpmnInteropResult`** — BPMN XML export result with warnings
- **`FlowExecutionStep`** — per-node execution tracking (status, timestamps, error, output)
- **`FlowDesignerSchema`** — component schema

## `FlowDesigner` component (`plugin-workflow`)

```tsx
<FlowDesigner
  schema={{
    type: 'flow-designer',
    title: 'Order Processing',
    concurrencyPolicy: 'forbid',
    nodes: [
      { id: 'start', type: 'start', label: 'Start', position: { x: 80, y: 200 } },
      {
        id: 'call-api', type: 'service_task', label: 'Call Payment API', position: { x: 300, y: 200 },
        executor: { type: 'http', inputSchema: { url: { type: 'string' } }, timeoutMs: 30000 },
      },
      {
        id: 'on-timeout', type: 'boundary_event', label: 'Timeout', position: { x: 300, y: 320 },
        boundaryConfig: { attachedToNodeId: 'call-api', eventType: 'timer', timer: 'PT30S', cancelActivity: true },
      },
      { id: 'check', type: 'condition', label: 'Check Result', position: { x: 520, y: 200 } },
    ],
    edges: [
      { id: 'e1', source: 'start', target: 'call-api' },
      { id: 'e2', source: 'call-api', target: 'check', type: 'conditional', condition: 'result.status === 200' },
      { id: 'e3', source: 'call-api', target: 'check', type: 'conditional', isDefault: true },
    ],
    showExecutionOverlay: true,
    executionSteps: [{ nodeId: 'call-api', status: 'running' }],
    showVersionHistory: true,
    versionHistory: [{ version: 2, createdAt: '2026-02-22T00:00:00Z', isCurrent: true, changeNote: 'Added timeout' }],
  }}
  onSave={(nodes, edges) => persist({ nodes, edges })}
/>
```

**Canvas interactions:** drag-to-reposition nodes, port-click edge creation, `Delete` key removal, `Ctrl+Z`/`Ctrl+Y` undo/redo, `Ctrl+S` save, zoom controls.

**Panels:** left node palette (all 14 types), right property panel (node label/type/executor/boundary config; edge label/type/condition/isDefault), version history side panel, BPMN XML export.

**Execution overlay:** per-node status icons (pending/running/completed/failed/skipped) driven by `executionSteps[]`.

Registered with `ComponentRegistry` as `'flow-designer'`. 15 new tests added; all 168 package tests pass.

## ROADMAP

- Added **P2.0 Flow Designer ✅** section with full checklist
- Marked P2.1 (conditional edges, v3.0.9 node types, edge creation UI, property editing) and P2.4 (`plugin-workflow` items) complete
